name: Unistar Enterprises
summary: Star-Tech Communications / Unistar Enterprises Pty Ltd (ACN 077 123 767); telecom & wireless engineering firm (brand founded 1990, corporate vehicle 2000) whose wholesale managed ISP division supplied broadband to university colleges; acquired by BigAir in two steps: ISP assets 1 Jul 2010, all shares 22 Apr 2014 (A$1.2m).

events.details: Star-Tech brand founded (wireless engineering); corporate vehicle incorporated 25 Jan 2000.
All shares acquired by BigAir (A$1.2m, completion 30 Apr 2014).
